text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs cabinet meeting.
- Iraq and Morocco discuss ways of boosting cultural ties.
- Baath party official receives Chinese delegation.
- Iraq's health ministry launches vaccination campaign.
- Endowments and religious affairs ministry publishes names of Iraqis eligible to go on pilgrimage to Mecca this year.
- Iraqi industrial delegation leaves for Egypt.
- (The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Editorial on current situation in northern Iraq and the need for Kurds to open dialogue with Baghdad.
- Editorial tells Kurds their succour comes from Saddam and not the United States or allies.
